name: Navascués / Nabaskoze (Spain)
description: Orange-red field charged at the centre with the arms of Navascués (chains, a fleur-de-lis and a cross on red and white, timbred with a helmet and white mantling).
history: Navascués, as head of the valley of its name, uses another shield which figured on the war flag: a castle of three towers surmounted in chief by a saltire, parted with or and three bends gules.
